main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 72-bar unusual move (return minus coin's mean 72-bar return)

statistic.name: t of mean of forecast x unusual move

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 and top-minus-bottom third > 0; reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean unusual move (by forecast)

decided_by: The weighted mean unusual move is > 0 with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom-third difference is > 0.
reading: The 30-day return is recomputed from closes 720 bars back inside each window and taken from the recorded regime where the window has fewer than 720 earlier bars; the coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean over all grid bars of all its windows; thirds are formed on all cases pooled across coins, sorted by forecast and split into three near-equal groups with numpy.array_split.
